issues.description: The UML and problem description specify Farm.animals as a private attribute with accompanying getter and setter, but the solution implementation declares the animals field as public (exposing internal state). This visibility mismatch contradicts the encapsulation shown in the problem statement and may confuse students about the expected visibility and design (the problem explicitly hints to implement getter/setter for a private field).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals attribute private in the Farm implementation (private List<Animal> animals;) while keeping the public getter and setter. This aligns the solution with the UML/problem statement and preserves encapsulation.
